notes: A failed Lyrics refetch no longer erases the words already saved on your song; the saved copy comes right back, and only a result you choose replaces it.
Album History Cancel now stops the active lookup chain, Singles refetch is wired to its visible button, and the converter X cancels and clears the current run so another link can start immediately.
Open Singles and Old songs from your saved lists first, without an automatic online search; tap Refetch or Refresh only when you want new results.
Old songs and album lists skip lo-fi mixes, nightcore, sped-up edits and other junk titles, and saved Singles are cleaned when they reopen.
The audio-format guide now sits before the backup converter, and every built-in converter offers the formats it can make: MP3, WAV, FLAC and AIFF.
The Discovery badge group is gone, including late-night listening counters; the remaining badge rewards follow the smaller wall.
